notes: B2 Hive includes Buzz farming rewards paid to BTC stakers
Public Distribution has no documented schedule ('released according to actual needs'), modelled as a cliff at TGE
Airdrops include the BUZZ 1, BUZZ 2, Testnet Odyssey and Bitcoin Extensive Networks Incentive campaigns

Airdrops.methodology: BUZZ I (5.5%), BUZZ II (5%), Testnet Odyssey (0.5%) and Bitcoin Extensive Networks Incentive airdrops

buzz-i.name: BUZZ I
buzz-i.methodology: 11.55M B2: 6.25% at TGE, then 50%/25%/12.5%/6.25% over the next 4 months

B2 Hive.methodology: On-chain liquidity mining tracked via the farming contract.

b2-hive.name: B2 Hive
b2-hive.methodology: Reads b2PerBlock, startBlock, endBlock from the farming contract on B-Squared. Total = b2PerBlock * (endBlock - startBlock).
